linda_cs: Heads-up — onboarding tenant 'helio' is seeing intermittent 429s on preflight when they ramp to ~200 concurrent users. Only in us-west-2 and started after they switched to our browser SDK. Logs below.

jon_eng: Can you paste the exact error payload? 429 from /v1/preflight usually means a fanout of parallel preflight requests. Any proxies/load balancers between them and our edge?

linda_cs: Error snippet: `HTTP 429 /v1/preflight -> {\"error\":\"rate_limit_exceeded\", \"retry_after\": 2}`. Repro curl we used: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/preflight \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <ephemeral-token>' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{\"model\":\"gpt-x\",\"prompt\":\"hi\"}'
```

matt_oncall: Is this from browsers or server workers? Browser preflight fanout on initial page load can easily create huge parallelism if tokens are fetched synchronously.

linda_cs: It's the React SPA. They mint ephemeral tokens with TTL=60s and the app calls the SDK init on every tab open. SDK version reported: `0.10.0`.

jon_eng: That explains it — 0.10.0 fires preflight on init + parallel token fetch in some cases. Two quick mitigation knobs: set `MAX_PREFLIGHT_CONCURRENCY` in the SDK and add jitter to token refresh. Ask them to try `MAX_PREFLIGHT_CONCURRENCY=6` as a quick test.

linda_cs: Can we reproduce here? I spun up 100 headless browsers hitting preflight and saw the same 429s. Attaching minimal repro script.

matt_oncall: Also check their infra for an intermediate proxy (NGINX, CDN) that might be coalescing connections — we had a prior case where a proxy burst caused our preflight bucket to see a large fanout. Any `X-Forwarded-*` in the gateway logs?

jon_eng: Another quick config to try from the SDK side: force a small backoff and disable connection reuse for preflight in your repro. Example config snippet to pass to the browser SDK: ```js
// in app init
window.REDWOOD_SDK_CONFIG = {
  MAX_PREFLIGHT_CONCURRENCY: 6,
  SDK_PREFLIGHT_BACKOFF_MS: 250,
  PREFLIGHT_JITTER_MS: 100,
  FORCE_NEW_SOCKET_FOR_PREFLIGHT: true
};
```

linda_cs: I'll ask the customer to test with those env overrides and to upgrade to `0.10.3` (contains a preflight batching fix). Sending repro steps and the exact SDK flags.

ci-deploy-bot: canary-deploy: Started rollout of sdk@0.10.3 to staging gateways (job #4321).

linda_cs: Quick update — customer ran with `MAX_PREFLIGHT_CONCURRENCY=6` and `SDK_PREFLIGHT_BACKOFF_MS=250` + ephemeral token jitter. After a 10-minute ramp to 300 tabs, the 429s stopped. Monitoring for 1h. :white_check_mark:

jon_eng: Awesome. Let's get a short KB article describing: recommended TTL > 30s, add jitter on token refresh, prefer MAX_PREFLIGHT_CONCURRENCY <= 10 for SPAs, and mention proxies can amplify bursts. I'll draft it.

matt_oncall: +1. Also add a note to ops to default safer envs in the next SDK release so new customers don't hit this by default. :thumbsup:
